name: Von Karman Vortex Street
desc: Flow past a hidden obstacle sheds alternating counter-rotating vortices that peel off into the classic staggered double row, warm and cool dye streaming downstream to reveal the swirling wake — as vorticity-tinted dye on dark fluid, grey schlieren shadowgraph, blue-to-white thermal false-color, indigo ink-in-water, or glowing neon flux.

swirl.doc: vortex circulation strength (0 = laminar streaks, 2 = tight violent rolls)

density.doc: grid resolution + number of shed vortices + dye-streak count/injection

scale.doc: street wavelength / vortex size (bigger = broader, fewer eddies)

hue.doc: warm-dye base hue (cool dye is its complement)
